title: ActionWaitUssdResponse
description: Prompts the user for input in the active USSD session, saves the response as a custom variable on the message, and triggers the associated response handler.

state_id.description: ID of the response handler that will be triggered when the response is received (e.g., "input"). Also used as the name of the variable where the USSD response will be stored (e.g. [[vars.input]]).
